It was a nice sunny day at the park when I spotted my target - this cute little nerdy boy sitting on a bench people-watching with his headphones in. He looked like he would be easy to manipulate and corrupt, just what I love!

After a while, he got up from the bench and started walking towards one of the public restrooms nearby. This was my perfect opportunity! I waited until nobody else was around before following him inside.

As soon as we were both in there alone together, with his back turned to me while standing at one of the urinals, I decided it was time for my big entrance!
